# Sherwin-Williams Industrial Coatings

> > Sherwin-Williams Industrial delivers specialized coating systems across aerospace, automotive, protective, and general industrial markets with advanced color management and application technologies.

Sherwin-Williams Industrial Coatings serves North American manufacturers with comprehensive paint and coating solutions spanning aerospace, automotive, marine, wood, packaging, and industrial applications. The division combines proprietary technologies like Sky Match Color Management System and PVDF coatings with expertise in regulatory compliance (AMS standards) and performance-driven formulations.

## Key Topics

- Industrial Coatings
- Aerospace Coatings
- Automotive Finishes
- Protective Coatings
- Corrosion Protection
- Coating Systems
- Aircraft Paints
- Color Management
- PVDF Technology
- Epoxy Coatings

## Transportation & Aerospace Coatings

- [Aerospace Paint & Coatings](https://industrial.sherwin-williams.com/na/us/en/aerospace.html): Aerospace coatings for commercial, personal, and military aircraft applications.
- [Automotive Finishes](https://industrial.sherwin-williams.com/na/us/en/automotive.html): Automotive paint and coating systems for refinishing and fleet industries.
- [Protective & Marine Coatings](https://industrial.sherwin-williams.com/na/us/en/protective-marine.html): Protective coatings for corrosion, fire, and harsh environment protection.

## Metal & Surface Coatings

- [Coil & Extrusion Coatings](https://industrial.sherwin-williams.com/na/us/en/coil-extrusion.html): Metal coil and extrusion coatings with PVDF technology and color solutions.
- [General Industrial Coatings](https://industrial.sherwin-williams.com/na/us/en/general-industrial.html): Liquid, powder, and electrocoat solutions for industrial manufacturing.

## Specialized Industrial Solutions

- [High Performance Flooring](https://industrial.sherwin-williams.com/na/us/en/resin-flooring.html): Durable seamless resinous flooring systems for commercial and industrial use.
- [Industrial Wood Coatings](https://industrial.sherwin-williams.com/na/us/en/industrial-wood.html): Wood coatings for furniture, cabinetry, and flooring manufacturers.
- [Packaging Coatings](https://industrial.sherwin-williams.com/na/us/en/packaging.html): Packaging coatings including valPure V70 non-BPA epoxy technology.
